{{Quote|The vitalicron is the vessel of memory. Each petitioner fills. In a vitalicron, the ceremony is preserved.|[[Amin-Le]]|audio=AminLe-Vitalicron-TOR.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''Vitalicron''' was an advanced [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] styled device used by the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era.

==Description==
These machines were designed to carry the memory and visions of those that went through the healing practices of the [[Voss Mystics|Mystics]] conducted at the [[Shrine of Healing|Wellspring of the Shrine of Healing]]. As a result, each device remembers the collective experience of everyone through a technological mean. Once the ceremony was complete the vitalicron was placed in the mystic's vaults, where each vitalicron was contained by a genetic lock to prevent access from anyone other than the individual whom had undergone the healing process of the mystics.

The [[Albathius|Shining Man]], an agent of the [[Star Cabal]], journeyed to [[Voss]] where he was accepted by the mystics because of a prophecy. He went through the healing ritual where his experiences were recorded in a vitalicron stored in the vaults. An [[Imperial Agent]] traveled to Voss to track down the Star Cabal and accessed the agent's vitalicron by using the Shining Man's ashes.
